evals.name: send-text-by-jid
evals.prompt: Send a WhatsApp text message to 12025550123@s.whatsapp.net saying 'Running late'.

evals.name: search-messages-filtered
evals.prompt: Search my WhatsApp messages for 'hello' from +12025550123 and only show text messages.

evals.name: list-messages-from-me
evals.prompt: List my 50 most recent WhatsApp messages sent by me.

evals.name: contact-show-and-alias
evals.prompt: Show contact details for 12025550123@s.whatsapp.net and set their alias to 'Mom'.

evals.name: groups-list-and-info
evals.prompt: List all my WhatsApp groups and fetch full info for the group with JID 1234567890@g.us.

evals.name: group-invite-link-get-and-revoke
evals.prompt: Get the current invite link for group 1234567890@g.us, then revoke it.

evals.name: first-trigger-missing-wacli
evals.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to Mom saying hi. Assume wacli is not installed.
evals.expected_behavior: Provide one of the documented install methods and do not silently install.

evals.name: ambiguous-recipient-pick
evals.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to 'John' saying 'see you soon'. There are two matching contacts: John Smith and John Doe.
evals.expected_behavior: Use --pick 1 or --pick 2, or ask the user which John. Must not guess.

evals.name: send-file-with-caption
evals.prompt: Send the file /tmp/photo.jpg to 12025550123@s.whatsapp.net with caption 'Look at this'.

evals.name: sync-once-and-backfill
evals.prompt: Sync WhatsApp once until idle, then backfill history for chat 12025550123@s.whatsapp.net.

evals.name: media-download-readonly-output
evals.prompt: Download the media file for message id MSG_001 in chat 12025550123@s.whatsapp.net to /tmp/media.jpg.

evals.name: poll-vote-in-group
evals.prompt: Vote for option 'Yes' on poll message POLL_001 in group 1234567890@g.us. I am the sender.

evals.name: profile-business-live
evals.expected_behavior: Must NOT include --read-only because profile business is a write operation.

evals.name: plain-text-output-request
evals.prompt: List my WhatsApp chats in plain text, not JSON.
evals.expected_behavior: Omit --json because user explicitly requested plain text.

evals.name: delete-message-no-readonly
evals.prompt: Delete WhatsApp message MSG_001 in chat 12025550123@s.whatsapp.net for everyone.
evals.expected_behavior: Must not include --read-only because delete is a write operation.

evals.name: show-messages-no-recipient
evals.expected_behavior: Resolve recipient or ask for it; must not fabricate a recipient.

evals.name: error-not-authenticated
evals.prompt: Send a WhatsApp text to 12025550123@s.whatsapp.net saying hi. wacli responds with error 'not authenticated'.
evals.expected_behavior: Run 'wacli auth' or ask the user to authenticate.

evals.name: error-store-locked
evals.prompt: Send a WhatsApp text to 12025550123@s.whatsapp.net saying hi. The first attempt fails with 'store is locked'.
evals.expected_behavior: Retry once with --lock-wait 30s, or ask user to stop wacli sync.
